gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Both frozen ZIP hashes and archive checks passed; all twelve candidate episodes had valid actions and local import/reset/act/RSS remained within the recorded limits. No inference-only privileged input was introduced.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The launch gate activated 120 times over twelve held-out episodes and all episodes exited at the image-speed limit. Median first-10-percent arrival improved from 3.76 to 2.80 seconds.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Candidate finished 10/12 matched held-out cells versus control 11/12. Candidate-only track 1 seed 2905 retired without a qualified finish at 99.25% progress. The candidate's faster completed-lap median cannot offset the lost finish under the registered completion-first rule.
